newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 116 OF MAY 6, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 116 OF MAY 6, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

DIRECTIVE 97/16/EC OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL of 10 April 1997 amending for the 15th time Directive 76/769/EEC on restrictions on the marketing and use of certain dangerous substances and preparations
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 819/97 of 5 May 1997 fixing the export refunds on pigmeat
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 818/97 of 5 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 817/97 of 5 May 1997 fixing the agricultural conversion rates
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 816/97 of 5 May 1997 fixing, for April 1997, the specific agricultural conversion rate for the amount of the reimbursement of storage costs in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 815/97 of 5 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 3665/87 laying down common detailed rules for the system of export refunds on agricultural products

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 814/97 of 5 May 1997 re amending Regulation (EC) No 2177/96 introducing preventive distillation as provided for in Article 38 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 822/87 for the 1996/97 wine year
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 812/97 of 5 May 1997 opening individual invitations to tender for the sale for export of vinous alcohol
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 811/97 of 5 May 1997 on the supply of vegetable oil as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 810/97 of 5 May 1997 providing for the rejection of applications for export licences in relation to cereal products END OF DOCUMENT.
